content.text: I'm thinking through how to approach this.

Several layout collisions and overlaps are present in the diagram. The "Fixed baseline" node obscures the "Observations" box's text and right edge. The "Residuals" box and "$b$" node, along with the "Corrected prediction" and "Evaluation" boxes also have overlapping text and borders. Text formatting issues such as awkward hyphenation and cramped equations are also present.

The diagram's connection routing is flawed, with an awkward label placement and arrow connection between the baseline and residuals. The annotation on the arrow from residuals to the scalar correction node is misplaced, and the scalar correction node overlaps the residuals box. Overall, horizontal node spacing requires adjustment to prevent any node overlap and ensure the canvas width accommodates all columns.
